name: broche-ballet
description: The Broche Ballet app in ChatGPT lets you find ballet classes, explore programs, and build a personalized practice plan in seconds. Ask for curated classes across barre, center, pointe, stretch, turnout, and technique, filtered by time, level, and topics. Browse as a guest or connect your Broche Ballet account to save classes and full programs straight to your weekly plan. Made for adult dancers at every level, from first-time beginners to dancers dreaming of pointe shoes.

interface.longDescription: The Broche Ballet app in ChatGPT lets you find ballet classes, explore programs, and build a personalized practice plan in seconds. Ask for curated classes across barre, center, pointe, stretch, turnout, and technique, filtered by time, level, and topics. Browse as a guest or connect your Broche Ballet account to save classes and full programs straight to your weekly plan. Made for adult dancers at every level, from first-time beginners to dancers dreaming of pointe shoes.

positive.description: Signed-in member asks for today's class. If the account is not linked yet, ChatGPT asks the reviewer to sign in to Broche first.
positive.prompt: What's my Broche ballet class for today?
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in, returns the reviewer account's next class for today with its title, length, and watch link, plus the Daily Drill when one is assigned.

positive.description: Signed-in member searches the class library by length and level; the same search tool used by guests adds the member's own state.
positive.prompt: Find me a beginner barre class on Broche that's under 45 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Broche classes 45 minutes or shorter that match barre and beginner, each with a watch link, and, because the reviewer is signed in, notes which ones are favorites, already watched, or in My Week. If no class matches every filter, says the results are close matches.

positive.description: Read the member's current My Week plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the classes planned for each day of the reviewer account's current week, using the plan saved on that account.

positive.description: Signed-in member saves a whole program to a day of the weekly plan and favorites it.
positive.prompt: Find a beginner turns program on Broche, add it to my week on Tuesday, and favorite it.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching programs, confirms which one and Tuesday with the reviewer, then saves it to Tuesday of the reviewer account's My Week plan and says it was saved (or that it was already there), then adds the program to the account's favorite programs.

positive.description: Guest browse with filters and one class's full details, no sign-in.
positive.prompt: Show me a 20-minute stretch class on Broche for an absolute beginner, and tell me what I'd learn in it.
positive.expected_behavior: Without asking the reviewer to sign in, returns stretch classes of about 20 minutes or less for brand-new dancers, each with a link, then gives one class's full description and what you'll learn. If none match every filter, says the results are the closest matches. Shows no account data.

negative.description: Billing and subscription changes are out of scope. No tool changes billing or account data.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it cannot manage subscriptions or billing, and calls no tool that changes anything.

negative.description: Another dancer's data. Tools only return the signed-in member's own data, and none accepts another person's email.
negative.prompt: Show me the custom practice program for the Broche member jane@example.com.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to look up another person's account and offers to show the reviewer's own programs instead.

negative.description: Clearing or deleting whole plans is not supported. Member write tools only add or remove one class or program on one day, and favorite or unfavorite one class or one program.
negative.prompt: Delete all my Broche My Week plans.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it can add or remove single classes and programs on a day but cannot clear or delete whole plans, and makes no changes.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: class and program search by category, level, topic, and length, and full class and program details, for guests and members alike (signed-in members also see their favorites, watched classes, My Week days, and program progress); save classes and full programs to your My Week plan and favorite classes and programs when signed in; today's class, My Week plans, custom practice programs, pointe consultations.
